description: the open hand presents the product: the palm tilts slightly up and down and the fingers flex a little, a few pixels only; the black sleeve on the left side of the picture stays perfectly still where it enters; then returns to the starting pose. The background and everything except the host stay absolutely identical in every frame, pixel-locked: no camera movement, no zoom, no pan, no flicker, no color shift; the red lacquer panels, gold trim, bulb arch, screen and counter do not move at all.
subject_description: a pale open hand and black suit sleeve stretched out above a red counter, a round turntable stand to the right, red set panel behind
initial_pose: arm stretched to the right, open palm facing up beside the turntable
